slides.title: Your logo is *not your brand.*
slides.sub: Your brand is what people say when you leave the room.

caption:
Many businesses spend weeks on a logo and minutes on what they actually stand for.

A logo helps people recognise you. A brand is the reason they come back and tell their friends.

It lives in how you answer WhatsApp messages, how you deliver, how you talk about your work and what customers say about you afterwards.

If you could only fix one: fix the reason, not the logo. What do you think people say about your business when you're not there?
